pages.lesson:
LESSON: WRITING 10.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: PACKING AND SHOPPING LISTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.5: Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Packing and Shopping lists

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Packing and Shopping lists. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What should one consider when grouping items in a packing list?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify ways of grouping items in packing and shopping lists
2. write a packing list for a specified event

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Packing and Shopping lists makes your writing clear so others can read it easily.

• Look at the model your teacher shows. Notice shape, order, and spacing.

• Practise slowly first, then build neat speed.

• Check your work: Did you spell carefully? Did you use correct marks?

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Copy three model sentences neatly, leaving finger spaces between words.

Example 2: Spell five lesson words aloud, then write them without looking.

Example 3: Fix this sentence by adding capital letters and a full stop: “amina went to kisumu”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Write five neat sentences about your school using words from this topic.
2. Exchange books with a friend and check spelling or punctuation together.
3. Rewrite one messy sentence so it is clear and correct.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Complete a short guided paragraph in your exercise book.
2. List eight words from this topic and practise spelling them with a parent.
3. Write a short note to a friend using correct punctuation.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the parts of a shopping list,
2. Create and fill a packing list template, and share with peers,
3. Discuss different ways of grouping items in packing and shopping lists,
4. Critical thinking: It is enhanced as learners categorise the various items included in a shopping and packing list in order of importance.
5. Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learners prepare and share a packing list with peers. Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What should one consider when grouping items in a packing list?
2. Why should a shopping list be prepared?
3. What is the importance of a packing list?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Neat writing helps the reader.
2. Check spelling and punctuation before you finish.
3. Practice a little every day.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
